31: 			num, dur = num + 1, dur + p.dur

33: 		end
34: 	end

38: 	return diseases
39: end

translation_snapshot.source:
Make your target's diseases burst, doing %0.2f blight damage for each disease it is infected with.
		This will also spread any diseases to any nearby foes in a radius of %d with a minimum duration of 6.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
使目标的疾病爆发，每种疾病造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		同时会将任意疾病传播给 %d 码半径内的附近敌人，疾病的持续时间最少为 6 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: Time and Space seem to warp and bend around the massive tip of this stave.
translation_snapshot.target: 法杖粗大的尖端周围，时空似乎发生了扭曲。
#LIGHT_BLUE#%s 从未存在，这一切从未发生！

translation_snapshot.source:
Leap onto an adjacent target with your shield, striking them for %d%% damage and dazing them for 2 turns, then using them as a springboard to leap to a tile within range %d.
The shield bash will use Dexterity instead of Strength for the shield's bonus damage.
At talent level 5, you will immediately enter a blocking stance on landing.
translation_snapshot.target:
用盾牌踩在临近目标上，造成 %d%% 伤害并眩晕 2 回合，之后将其做为跳板跃向 %d 格内的空地。
盾袭将使用敏捷代替力量决定盾牌的属性伤害加成。
技能等级 5 时，你将在落地后立刻进入格挡状态。

translation_snapshot.source:
Unleash your subconscious on the world around you.  While active, you fire up to %d bolts each turn (one per hostile target) that deal %0.2f mind damage.  Each bolt consumes 5 Feedback.
		Feedback gains beyond your maximum allowed amount may generate extra bolts (one bolt per %d excess Feedback per target), but no more than %d extra bolts per turn. 
		This effect is a psionic channel, increasing the range of Mind Sear, Psychic Lobotomy, and Sunder Mind to 10 but will break if you move.
		The damage will scale with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
将你的潜意识释放到周围的世界。当此技能激活时，每回合你最多射出 %d 枚心灵飞弹（每个敌方目标一枚），造成 %0.2f 精神伤害。每枚飞弹消耗 5 点反馈值。
		当获得的反馈值超出最大值时，你会产生额外的飞弹（每个目标每超出 %d 点反馈值产生 1 枚飞弹），但每回合产生的额外飞弹不超过 %d 枚。
		此效果是一种灵能通道，可将心灵灼烧、心灵脑叶切除和碾碎心灵的射程提升至 10，但你一旦移动便会中断。
		受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
Sing a song of decay and defiance and sustain yourself through spite.
							Each time you suffer a detrimental effect, you gain a shield with strength %d, that lasts as long as the effect would.  This will add to and extend an existing shield if possible.
							This can only trigger once every %d turns
translation_snapshot.target:
唱响腐朽与抗争之歌，以怨恨支撑自身。
							每次你受到负面状态时，你获得强度为 %d 的护盾，持续时间与该状态相同。如果可能，此效果会叠加到已有护盾并延长其持续时间。
							这一效果每 %d 回合只能触发一次。
